## Summary

`VisionAttention.forward()` already computes MiMo-style local-window and learned-sink arguments, but the FA4 backend wrapper discarded both at the external FlashAttention call. This change forwards `window_size`, forwards `s_aux` as `sinks` only when present, and retains `ver=4`.

I inspected the existing FA3 implementation, the related Triton investigation, and open upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38872 before changing the code. The production change intentionally matches the established FA3 contract and that upstream candidate rather than introducing a separate interface.

Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/38871

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/719

## Reproduction and tests

Using the prepared checkout at base `358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365`, I first added the regression and ran it against the unchanged FA4 wrapper:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-9ad1f4f7fdea/venv/bin/python \
  -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_vision_fa4_attention.py
```

All five cases failed: four external-boundary cases observed no `window_size`, and the actual `VisionAttention -> VisionFlash4Attention` case disagreed with an independent explicit-mask/learned-sink tensor reference.

After the fix:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-9ad1f4f7fdea/venv/bin/python \
  -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_vision_fa4_attention.py \
  test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_vision_max_seqlen.py
```

Result: `12 passed`. Coverage includes default full-window/no-sink behavior, window-only, sink-only, combined window/sink behavior, `ver=4`, the actual VisionAttention routing path, the independent numerical reference, and existing max-seqlen handling.

Adjacent checks:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-9ad1f4f7fdea/venv/bin/python \
  -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_vision_backend_selection.py \
  test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_vision_strided_qkv.py
```

Result: `24 passed`. `git diff --check` and Python compilation also passed. The prepared interpreter does not include `ruff`, which is recorded in the result report.

Raw JUnit output and full claims are under `reports/j-9ad1f4f7fdea/`.

## Limits

This environment exposes one AMD Instinct MI355X with Torch `2.11.0+rocm7.2` / HIP `7.2.26015`. The reported FA4 CUTE kernel and Blackwell model path are CUDA-only, so no FA4 GPU kernel or MiMo-V2.5 multimodal model was executed here. The instrumented boundary and independent reference are CPU tests and are not claimed as GPU execution. No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
